note: No known issues as of 2026-09-16. Design Automation engines are typically supported for 4 years after release, then deprecated for 2 more before removal (Autodesk's published engine lifecycle policy) - recheck this row well before 2028.

Autodesk previewed migrating Revit 2025's runtime to .NET 10 in the same wave as Revit 2026 (preview announced ~2026-04-28). If/when that ships for real on Design Automation too, this row's tfm will need to move to net10.0-windows the same way 2026 does below. Run --list-engines and don't assume.

Autodesk's APS blog announced the Revit 2026 Design Automation engine is being force-upgraded to Revit 2026.5 + .NET 10 on 2026-09-21, and stated they will NOT keep it on the older .NET version after that migration - this is not optional. After that date, change tfm above to net10.0-windows, rebuild with pack-bundle.ps1 -RevitYear 2026, and re-register. Before that date this row (net8.0-windows) is still correct.

Revit 2027 desktop shipped ~2026-04-07 and confirmed uses .NET 10, but as of 2026-09-16 no Autodesk announcement of an Autodesk.Revit+2027 Design Automation engine could be found via search. Run `node scripts/appbundle-register.js --list-engines` and check the output for an entry containing 'Revit+2027' BEFORE building/registering this row - if it isn't listed yet, this year isn't usable on Design Automation yet regardless of what this file says.
